notes.title: Version 1.0.7
notes.content:
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Several freeze bugs related to menu navigation have been fixed
[*] Mouse cursor wasn't showing correctly
[*] Quit application button was shown in settings when it shouldn't
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The order execution phase can now be sped up and slowed down at will
[*] Interaction terms within the tips menu have been generalized to accomodate for clicking and tapping
[/list]
